title: Language Model Council: Democratically Benchmarking Foundation Models on Highly Subjective Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating how often an LLM judge favors a specific position (first or second) by evaluating pairwise positional consistency across order-swapped response pairings.
Measuring the difference between an LLM's rating of its own generated responses (affinity to itself) and the overall council's consensus score for that same model.
Calculating the R-squared value of a linear regression model that predicts the evaluation score assigned by an LLM judge based on the average word length of the evaluated responses.
Observing how the selection of a specific reference model in arena-style pairwise evaluations inadvertently inflates the win rates of newer or larger models from the same model family.
